title: The PCS Project Podcast -Episode 2 - Moving in the Military
description:
Hello and welcome back to The PCS Project Podcast I have another NEW episode for y'all. I am discussing moving in the military, the mental and physical drain that comes with in, what I have learned in my own experience and touching on a bit of real estate and sharing some information about the VA loan (are we surprised) it is my pride and passion that I get to help families from all over find their home. Kick back and relax while we dive into this episode together. I would love to hear your thoughts in the comments below. If you're interested in following me along my journey all my links are below.
